title: Turtlemint flags lower income for agents under IRDAI proposed commission curbs, pushes beyond insurance
summary:
Turtlemint says IRDAI's proposed commission caps could reduce monthly PoSP earnings by Rs 1,000 more than those of insurance agents selling the same number of policies.

The post Turtlemint flags lower income for agents under IRDAI proposed commission curbs, pushes beyond insurance appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Turtlemint warns that the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India’s (IRDAI) plan to cap commissions could cut the monthly earnings of point‑of‑sale‑person (PoSP) agents by about ₹1,000 compared with traditional insurance agents selling the same number of policies.
